body: Cast when Stunned and Cast when Damage Taken have no rate for their condition in PoB: the triggered skill is counted as firing at its cooldown, as if you were always stunned or always taking the damage. Cast on Death marks the skill as triggered with no death condition at all. The gem optimizer never picks them.
evidence: CalcTriggers.lua (PoB 2.68.1): 'cast when stunned' returns only the trigger chance and the skill itself as the source, with no stun frequency. concept.py on a self-cast Fireball Elementalist replaced Spell Echo with Cast when Stunned plus Cooldown Recovery in the 6-link.
title: PoB credits condition triggers as if always triggered

body: PoB's misc calculator doesn't drop a socketed jewel's stats the way a full recalculation does, so a probe that deallocates a socket with a jewel in it gives wrong numbers. eval probes refuse it; use apply.
evidence: test-eval.py (phase 3): probe deltas for such removals differed from editing the XML and reloading it.
title: Calculator probes are wrong when a removed node holds a jewel

body: TotalEHP simulates a run of enemy hits against your pools and mitigation. Between hits only gains when hit (life, mana or ES when hit) refill the pools, and recoup is tracked; leech, regeneration and on-kill recovery aren't used. Compare builds that differ there by hand.
evidence: CalcDefence.lua numberOfHitsToDie (PoB 2.68.1): pools refill only through GainWhenHit and tracked recoup; no regeneration, leech or on-kill stats are read inside the loop.
title: PoB's EHP leaves out leech, regen and on-kill recovery

body: A few uncorrupted 20/20 copies of cheap gems are listed at absurd prices and still pass a minimum-listings filter. Ordinary gems are now priced as the cheaper of a max-level listing and a level 1 copy at the quality, levelled by the player.
evidence: Covens: Fireball 20/20 at 2,015 chaos on 3 listings while Fireball 1/20 was 1 chaos on 106 listings.
title: Price-fixed max-level gem listings on poe.ninja

body: poe.ninja lists few awakened or exceptional gems this league, so with a budget an unlisted one counts as unavailable, not cheap. Re-check each league.
evidence: poe.ninja SkillGem overview for Covens: among awakened and exceptional supports only Empower, Enhance and Enlighten had listings.
title: Most awakened gems aren't in the Covens economy

body: rarecost.py prices a crafted rare from its affix tiers. Even after cutting the table to about a third, it stays above what the trade site shows for the same mods, so budgets err on the safe side. Re-calibrate each league with --trade-check.
evidence: Covens trade checks: wand 0.16 vs 0.83 estimated, belt 0.07 vs 0.37, boots 0.05 vs 1.9 (first table); the table was then cut to about a third.
title: The rare-cost estimate runs above trade prices
